validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: Confirmed real and under construction. P6729 is Package 9 of Saudi Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS III): the 56-inch EWJZG-1 trunk line, segment BGCS-10 to Sector I STS-2, 458 km. Three fully independent sources beyond MEED agree on the exact segment name, 56in and 458km: MEED ('Laying 56-inch EWJZG-1 from BGCS-10 to sector one STS-2, covering 458km'), Oil & Gas News (OGN, project-tracking outlet) and DMS Projects (project database). OGN reports construction underway: 'As of August 2025, Qapqa has commenced welding activities' with main contractor A.Hak International. CLASSIFICATION: Confirmed gas transmission. MGS = Master Gas System; the line carries 'sales gas around the Kingdom' via the East-West pipeline system, i.e. a dry-gas trunk transmission line, not NGL/gathering. Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission are correct. DUPLICATE: Not a duplicate. Adjacent EWJZG-1 segments are distinct rows with distinct endpoints/lengths: P6730 (STS-2->STS-1, 310km) and P6731 (STS-1->Shoqaiq, 462km). P6729 alone is BGCS-10->STS-2 at 458km, so no relabel/double-count. ATTRIBUTION: Owner/Operator = Saudi Aramco, confirmed by MEED, OGN and DMS. SPEC: Length 458km and Diameter 56in corroborated by 3 independent sources (MEED, OGN, DMS) -> high. Status=construction corroborated (welding underway Aug 2025). CAVEAT on dates: GEM StartYear1=2028 reflects the whole MGS III network commissioning (Aramco). OGN/DMS give this segment a Q3-2024 construction start and an expected Q1-2026 mechanical completion; 2028 is a network-level operational date, not this segment's completion, so it is defensible but worth a note. The Aramco $25bn award page (current Start [ref]) was unreachable (ReadTimeout) at audit time; the 2028 value is otherwise supported by the gem.wiki-cited Aramco page and MEED context, so left in place rather than flagged as a spec concern.
